$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for IDE support

sourceDir.description: Directory containing Void source conventions such as pages, routes, middleware, crons, queues, db, auth.ts, and env.ts. Omit to use the project root.

target.description: Deploy target runtime. Defaults to "cloudflare". Non-CF targets disable bindings (D1, KV, R2, AI) and produce a plain Hono app.

output.description: Output mode. "server" (default) serves all pages dynamically. "static" prerenders all pages at build time, writing HTML files to dist/client/.

auth.description: High-level Better Auth configuration. Use this to select built-in auth providers; use auth.ts for advanced Better Auth options.

providers.description: Auth providers to enable. Include "email" for email/password auth. Social providers use standardized env vars like AUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and AUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.

head.description: Default <head> tags for all pages. Page-level head() exports override these defaults.

titleTemplate.description: Title template — %s is replaced with the page title. Example: "%s | My Site"

htmlAttrs.description: Attributes to add to the <html> element. Example: { "lang": "en" }

bodyAttrs.description: Attributes to add to the <body> element

routing.description: Routing configuration — headers, redirects, rewrites, fallbacks, revalidation, prerendering.

alwaysUseHttps.description: Redirect HTTP requests to HTTPS with a permanent 308 redirect. Omit to inherit the hosting platform default (currently off). Local development continues to support HTTP.

isr.description: Enable inferred ISR caching. Set false to disable ISR and edge prerendering, including per-page prerender and revalidate policies. Does not disable output: static build-time prerendering.

notFound.description: Override how the asset layer answers a request that matched no asset and no worker route. Void infers "single-page-application" when the worker does not own HTML routing; set "404-page" for a static-site-generator build so unknown URLs serve 404.html with a real HTTP 404 instead of index.html with a 200. Does not change run_worker_first. Ignored for SvelteKit, Nuxt, Analog, and Astro deploys, which pin not_found_handling to "none" because the framework's own worker owns unmatched HTML.

revalidate.description: Edge caching TTL in seconds. A number sets a global TTL for all SSR pages. An object maps URL patterns to TTLs (first match wins). Set to 0 to disable caching for a path.

prerender.description: Explicit paths to prerender at deploy time. Each path must start with "/".

headers.description: Custom response headers for static assets. Keys are URL patterns (e.g. "/assets/*"), values are arrays of "Name: value" strings.

redirects.description: URL redirects. Keys are source URL patterns (path-only `/path` or host-scoped `https://host/path`); values are destination strings (302) or objects with "to" and optional "status".

revalidateQueryAllowlist.description: Query parameters that are part of the ISR cache key for every request to a matching path. Keys are source URL patterns; values are arrays of query parameter names. All other query parameters are left out of the key. When omitted, ISR drops every query parameter from the cache key.

rewrites.description: URL rewrites. Keys are source URL patterns (path-only `/path` or host-scoped `https://host/path`); values are destination paths. Serves content from the destination without changing the browser URL. Destinations must start with "/" and must not contain "?" — the incoming request's query string is preserved automatically.

fallbacks.description: Fallback rewrites. Same shape as `rewrites`, but only fire when no static asset matched the request. Useful for SPA shells or default-locale catch-alls without pre-empting real routes. Destinations must start with "/" and must not contain "?".

inference.description: Inference configuration — bindings, scanDirs, build, outputDir, appType.

bindings.description: Explicitly control inferred Cloudflare bindings. If omitted, bindings are inferred by scanning source files.

db.description: Enable D1 database binding. `true` uses default name "DB", a string sets a custom binding name.

kv.description: Enable KV namespace binding. `true` uses default name "KV", a string sets a custom binding name.

storage.description: Enable R2 bucket binding. `true` uses default name "STORAGE", a string sets a custom binding name.

ai.description: Enable Workers AI binding. `true` uses default name "AI", a string sets a custom binding name.

scanDirs.description: Directories to scan for binding inference, relative to the project root. Overrides the default scan directories.

build.description: Custom build command. Overrides the framework preset's default build command.

outputDir.description: Output directory for static deploys. Relative to project root.

appType.description: App type. If omitted, auto-detected on first deploy.

remote.description: Connect to remote D1/KV/R2 bindings during local development. Can also be set via VOID_REMOTE=1 environment variable.

sandbox.description: Enable Cloudflare Sandboxes. `true` uses the default SANDBOX binding and Node.js environment; an object customizes the Durable Object binding, container image, and instance size.

binding.description: Worker binding name for the sandbox Durable Object namespace. Defaults to SANDBOX.

className.description: Durable Object class name. Defaults to SandboxV1.

containerName.description: Cloudflare Container application name. Defaults to void-sandbox-v1.

image.description: Dockerfile path or digest-pinned Cloudflare managed registry image for local and native Cloudflare use.

imageBuildContext.description: Optional Docker build context path for local development and native Cloudflare deploys.

platformImage.description: Cloudflare managed registry image pinned by digest, containing the SDK 1.0 sandbox-shim. Defaults to Cloudflare’s managed Node.js image.

worker.description: Curated wrangler config passthrough. Cloudflare-targeted apps require compatibility_date here unless provided by wrangler.jsonc/wrangler.json; Void pins the latest known-good date here if none is configured. Binding arrays (d1_databases, kv_namespaces, r2_buckets) are not allowed here — bindings are fully managed by void.

cpu_ms.description: Caps Workers CPU time per request, in milliseconds (max 300000 = 5 minutes). The platform plan may cap it lower.

deploy.description: Void deployment choices. Cloudflare Worker settings belong in cloudflare instead.

mode.description: Staged is the default and verifies readiness before traffic. Atomic publishes a Durable Object Worker directly and verifies readiness afterward.

database.description: Database backend. Omit for D1 (SQLite, default). Set to "pg" for PostgreSQL or "mysql" for MySQL via Hyperdrive, or use an object to also set the column casing.

casing.description: Drizzle casing: how columns declared without a name are named in the database, for queries and generated migrations.

ai.description: AI configuration for self-hosted deploys. Configures the Cloudflare AI Gateway used by ai.provider().fetch() (Workers AI ai.run/ai.image use the env.AI binding directly and are not affected).

gateway.description: Cloudflare AI Gateway name/slug to route ai.provider().fetch() through your own account.

from.description: Default sender for sendEmail(): one address, optionally with a display name ("Acme <noreply@mail.acme.com>"). On `void deploy --backend cloudflare` its host is the domain Void sets Email Routing and Email Sending up on.
